Metadata.title: Find a proven social solution
Metadata.description: Describe a problem in your own words and we will point you to proven social innovations from the ROPS Kraków library.

Footer.tagline: The Social Innovation Hub connects the needs of Małopolska residents with proven solutions.
Footer.sourceNote: Data comes from the public Social Innovation Library of ROPS Kraków. Every result links to its source.

hero.title: Describe the problem. <highlight>Find a solution</highlight> that already works.
hero.lead: A few sentences are enough – we show proven innovations and explain why they fit.

search.label: What is happening?
search.placeholder: E.g. in our municipality young people have nowhere to go and feel lonely…

examples.senior: An older neighbour lives alone and feels lonely
examples.disability: Our municipality lacks services for people with disabilities
examples.youth: Young people in our town struggle with stress

describe.title: Describe the problem
describe.text: Write in your own words what is happening. No technical terms needed.

review.title: See the matches
review.text: We show proven innovations and explain why they fit your situation.

act.title: Use it or report it
act.text: Read how to implement the solution. If nothing fits, report the need to ROPS.

categories.title: Browse by category
categories.description: The nine categories of the ROPS Kraków Social Innovation Library (their names stay in Polish).

featured.title: Examples from the library
featured.description: With a description of the test, the licence and a link to the source.

submitCallout.title: Did not find an answer?
submitCallout.text: Report a need or an idea. ROPS staff will reply, and you can check the status through a private link.

problem.tooShort: Describe the problem in at least {min} characters.
problem.tooLong: The description can have at most {max} characters.

header.title: Solutions for your problem
header.lead: Proven social innovations from the ROPS Kraków library, best matches first.

card.noEvidence: The ROPS library has no description of a test.

noMatch.title: We did not find a close match
noMatch.text: The library has no solution that clearly fits this description. You can report the need to ROPS or browse the library.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.text: We could not load the results. Please try again in a moment.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.text: Too many requests were sent in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.

emptySearch.title: Describe the problem first
emptySearch.text: There is no description to search for yet. Go back to the home page and describe what is happening.

submitPrompt.title: Nothing fits?
submitPrompt.text: Report a need and ROPS staff will reply.

lowConfidence.title: We did not find a close match
lowConfidence.text: Below are the nearest solutions in the library. They may fit only partly. If none fits, report the need to ROPS.

InnovationDetail.missingSection: The ROPS library has no description here.
InnovationDetail.missingEvidence: The ROPS library has no description of a test.

cta.title: Have a need of your own?
cta.text: If this solution does not fit, report the need to ROPS.

notFound.title: We could not find this solution
notFound.text: The link may be outdated or the solution was removed from the library.

need.title: Report a need
need.lead: Describe a problem we found no solution for. ROPS staff will read your report and reply.

idea.title: Propose an idea
idea.lead: Share an idea for a social innovation, even one that is only at the beginning.

fields.descriptionHint: Do not include personal data, for example names of other people.

targetGroup.label: Who is this idea for?
targetGroup.hint: For example: lonely seniors in rural areas.

stage.legend: What stage is the idea at?

email.label: Email address (optional)
email.hint: We will send the link to your submission there. Without an address, save the link shown after sending.
email.consent: I agree that ROPS Kraków sends the link to my submission to this email address.

errors.descriptionTooShort: Describe it in at least {descriptionMin} characters.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can have at most {descriptionMax} characters.
errors.titleTooShort: The title should have at least {titleMin} characters.
errors.titleTooLong: The title can have at most {titleMax} characters.
errors.targetGroupTooShort: Say who the idea is for (at least {targetGroupMin} characters).
errors.targetGroupTooLong: This text can have at most {targetGroupMax} characters.
errors.stageRequired: Choose the stage of the idea.
errors.placeTooLong: The place name can have at most {placeMax} characters.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address or leave the field empty.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the consent box or remove the email address.

generic.text: Please try again in a moment. Your text is still in the form.

rateLimited.title: Too many submissions
rateLimited.text: Too many submissions were sent in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.

nextSteps.title: What happens next?

steps.read: A ROPS Kraków staff member reads your submission.
steps.reply: They may reply or ask for details.
steps.track: You see the reply through a private link, no sign-in needed.

nextSteps.privacy: Your submission goes to ROPS Kraków staff.

created.title: Submission received
created.text: Thank you. This is the private page of your submission. The reply from ROPS Kraków will appear here.
created.warning: Save this link. Without it (and without an email address) you cannot return to your submission.

reply.title: Reply from ROPS Kraków
reply.none: There is no reply yet. Come back to this page later using the saved link.

notFound.title: We could not find this submission
notFound.text: Check that the link is complete. If you lost it, you can send a new submission.
